title: The Atlas of the Lower Danube
author: Sebastian Iversen
blurb: Ivo Delacroix, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
